name: Remove Active/Active Keycloak
description: Targets and owned resources come from the hub deployment record. Vault and shared applications are preserved.

spec.question_description: Selects the deployment record; clusters, database reference and public endpoint are read from that record.
Remove requires an enabled Git profile, exact hostname/database confirmations and the selected backup policy.

Reload by default. Select stop-start when a temporary shared-service interruption is needed; restart and running-state verification are required before continuing. An already stopped/disabled service stays unchanged.
Enter REMOVE followed by a space and the exact public hostname.
Must match both ESO database secrets. Confirms this database is exclusively for this Keycloak deployment.
verified-backup requires a backup reference. no-backup permanently discards Keycloak database contents and requires the separate data-loss confirmation.
Required for verified-backup. Supply an independently checked backup ID or restore-point reference. Leave empty for no-backup. The workflow does not create or validate backups.
For no-backup, enter DELETE <database-name> WITHOUT BACKUP using the exact Dedicated database name. Example: DELETE keycloak_db WITHOUT BACKUP. Leave empty for verified-backup.
